findings.claim_attacked: years 2010-2026 preserved (2026 counted as a preserved year)
findings.finding: Every one of the 60 files labelled year 2026 ends on 2026-07-31. They hold 196-212 days of a 365-day year. The capture ran on 2026-09-06, so 37 already-elapsed days of 2026 are absent - and this is not a fetch-timing artefact, because the source's own `aggiornamento` stamp on those same tables is 2026-08-25, i.e. the source refreshed after July and still published nothing past 2026-07-31. Separately, the manifest's `missing_days` for 2026 is computed against expected_days=365 and labelled PARTIAL_SOURCE_GAP, which fuses two different things into one number: for Zero Branco BFOGL 2026, missing_days=169 = 153 days of the year that have not been published at all + 16 genuine gaps inside the published Jan-Jul span. A reader cannot tell data loss from calendar remainder, and days that have not happened are labelled as a SOURCE_GAP.

findings.claim_attacked: C2 - 100% of rows carry a value (implying each row is a usable daily observation of the variable)
findings.finding: The row-level claim holds, but relative humidity has no daily mean at all: every UMID2M `valore` is a JSON object with only MINIMO and MASSIMO - there is no MEDIO field, unlike temperature which has MINIMO/MEDIO/MASSIMO. So 81,207 humidity rows are a daily range, not a daily mean. Anyone reading "366,978 rows, 100% carry a value" as 366,978 daily readings of five variables will silently substitute a min/max range for a mean.
findings.corrected_value: 81,207 UMID2M rows carry MINIMO and MASSIMO only. Daily MEAN relative humidity is NOT_PRESERVED for every station and every year.
